name: PoliceStation
concept: The gendarmerie post of 1989 Everon: the vanilla Villa_E_2I01_Police (a two-storey villa with a barred holding cell, a hall with stairs, two offices on the ground floor and offices upstairs) fitted out as a working police station. The public comes in the front door into the hall: the licence and permit desk and the wanted board are there. The duty room behind it has the duty desk (clock in and out), the armory locker and the armory store (issue offers), the evidence locker and the dispatch board. Upstairs are the records room with the case board and the commander's office; the interview room is the first-floor desk with two chairs and a tape recorder. The holding cell is the villa's own barred cell. In front, patrol cars, a spike strip and the payphone stand in the yard. Era-current base-game props only (typewriters, grey phones, cork boards, tape recorder, flipchart): no antique or rustic pieces. Built in a GridWorld multi-cell claim as the reusable kit for the Everon town pipeline (epic #2201); Saint-Philippe placement happens later through `town fit`.

kit.origin: origin.mjs (where the villa stands in the claim; the kit rows are building space, front toward +z)

passes.2: POLISH 1: lights, walls, desks, interview room
passes.3: POLISH 2: facade, yard dressing, night mood

vanilla.furniture: its own Villa_E_2I01_furniture_02 (the villa ships furnished: desks, benches, bunk, kitchenette, files)

rooms.what: entrance hall with the stairs: licence and permit desk, wanted board, notices
duty room: duty desk, armory locker and store, evidence locker, dispatch board
the villa's barred holding cell (LF_JailCell staged only with --with-cell)
the kitchenette and canteen table at the front
records room: case board, files, commander's desk across the corridor
interview room: school desk, two chairs, tape recorder, desk lamp
patrol cars, spike strip, payphone, bench and bins in the claim's yard

systems.duty: LF_PoliceDutyDesk (clock in, duty pay) and LF_ArmoryStore plus the armory cabinet (LF_PoliceRanks armory, issue offers #1763)
systems.jail: LF_JailCell and EL_JailDoor, staged with --with-cell (one placed cell per world; GridWorld already has one)
systems.vehicles: LF_UAZ469_Police patrol and escort cars, SpikeStrip

budget.rules: CastShadow set on every light and never on a point light; vanilla props with LODs, static decor with no physics, no per-frame scripts on decoration; lamps look lit through an emissive material, not one light per prop
